description: A React component that renders a responsive time-series chart showing deployment counts over time, with data fetching, filtering by date range, and theming support.

methods.name: withAlpha
methods.description: Converts a hex color to an rgba string with specified alpha transparency.

methods.name: toLocalDateString
methods.description: Converts a date/time value to a local date string in YYYY-MM-DD format.

methods.name: applyTimeRange
methods.description: Filters deployment data based on the selected time range (7d, 30d, 90d, all).
